stdout.text:
Start an MCP server that exposes vault operations to AI agents.

Each agent must be configured in the agents section of the config file
(default: <ROOT:0>/root/config/symaira-vault/config.yaml; existing installs may use the legacy
~/.symvault/config.yaml) with specific permissions and scope restrictions.

The server can run in stdio mode or HTTP mode.

Usage:
  symvault mcp [flags]
  symvault mcp [command]

Examples:
  # stdio mode for a single agent (called by MCP clients directly, canonical)
  symvault mcp --stdio --agent claude-code

  # HTTP mode bound to localhost:<PORT:0>
  symvault mcp --bind 127.0.0.1 --port <PORT:0>

  # Install as a system service (macOS launchd or systemd)
  symvault mcp install

Available Commands:
  install     Install MCP server as a background service
  status      Show MCP server service status
  uninstall   Remove the MCP server background service

Flags:
      --agent string      Agent name (required for --stdio; HTTP mode resolves agents per-request via X-Symaira-Agent header)
      --allow-locked      Allow the MCP server to start even when the vault is locked (stdio mode only)
      --bind string       Bind address for HTTP server (default "127.0.0.1")
  -h, --help              help for mcp
      --port int          Server port (default <PORT:0>)
      --stdio             Enable stdio transport (for MCP)
      --tls-ca string     CA certificate file path for mTLS client verification (enables mTLS)
      --tls-cert string   TLS certificate file path (overrides config)
      --tls-key string    TLS key file path (overrides config)

Global Flags:
      --color string      When to emit ANSI color: auto, always, never (default "auto")
      --json              Output format shorthand for --output json; overrides --output when both are specified
      --no-pipe-warning   suppress 'reading from non-TTY' warning when piping secrets
      --output string     Output format (text, json, yaml) (default "text")
      --profile string    use a named vault profile
      --quiet             suppress non-error output
      --theme string      Color preset: default, highcontrast, colorblind (or SYMVAULT_THEME)
      --vault string      path to the password vault (default "~/.symvault")

Use "symvault mcp [command] --help" for more information about a command.

[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
	filemode = true
	bare = false
	logallrefupdates = true
	ignorecase = true
	precomposeunicode = true
[user]
	name = Symaira Vault
	email = symvault@example.com
Unnamed repository; edit this file 'description' to name the repository.

# git ls-files --others --exclude-from=.git/info/exclude
# Lines that start with '#' are comments.
# For a project mostly in C, the following would be a good set of
# exclude patterns (uncomment them if you want to use them):
# *.[oa]
# *~
/.symvault-rust

# Symaira Vault vault - ignore sensitive files
identity.age
.device-id
*.key
*.pem
# Ignore Symaira Vault runtime artifacts
mcp-token
mcp-tokens.json
.runtime-port
# Ignore OS files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
# Ignore IDE files
.idea/
.vscode/
*.swp
*.swo
*~

agents:
    cli:
        allowedPaths:
            - '*'
        canWrite: true
        exposeValueTools: false
vault:
    authMethod: passphrase
    search_index: true
    auto_heal_zero_key: true
git:
    commit_template: Update from Symaira Vault
    auto_push: true
    auto_pull: false
vaultDir: <ROOT:0>/root
defaultAgent: cli
sessionTimeout: 15m0s
sessionMaxLifetime: 8h0m0s
authMethod: passphrase

        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: true

        canWrite: true
        exposeValueTools: false

        canWrite: false
        canRunCommands: false
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
